sources.entry: Convrt - Offline menu bar file converter: hold Shift while dragging files and drop them on a wheel that only shows the formats and tools that fit them, with a command-line version. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/atuuuuuuu/Convrt) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: Convrt is an offline macOS menu bar app (with a command-line version) that opens a context wheel when you hold Shift while dragging files, for converting, editing and sending them.
summary.what_it_does: Convrt sits in the macOS menu bar. When you drag files and hold Shift, a wheel opens at the cursor showing only the formats and tools that fit those files. Images can be converted among PNG, JPG, HEIC, TIFF, BMP, GIF or PDF; audio among WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, AIFF; and video (MOV, MP4, M4V) to MOV, MP4 or audio-only. Image tools include compress, resize, strip EXIF/GPS data, rotate, flip, crop and background cut-out; video tools include mute, trim, snapshot and extract audio; PDF tools include merge, split and get text; any file can be zipped, unzipped or inspected. Results are saved next to the originals and never overwrite them. The same engine is available as a convrt command-line tool, and a Drop Zone window offers the same wheels without needing special permissions.
use_cases: convert HEIC photos to JPG on a Mac
merge several PDFs or images into one PDF
remove location data from photos before sharing
trim or mute a video clip
automatically convert files dropped into a watched folder
how_to_run: Download Convrt-macOS.zip from the latest release, unzip it and move Convrt to Applications
Open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway for Convrt, then confirm
Grant Accessibility and Input Monitoring (menu bar icon → Check Permissions…), then restart Convrt
Optional: brew install lame to enable MP3 output
notable: Holds-Shift radial wheel that filters options to the dragged file types
Fully offline: no network code, accounts or analytics
Non-destructive: outputs land beside originals and are never overwritten; Undo moves results to Trash
Drop Zone window and command-line tool share the same engine and work without Accessibility permissions
Watch Folders auto-convert files once they finish copying, without deleting originals
caveats: Not notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks first launch and needs manual approval in System Settings
Requires Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions for the Shift-drag wheel (Drop Zone avoids this)
MP3 writing needs the optional lame install; macOS can read MP3 but not write it
Not yet supported: browser image drag, OGG/WebM/MKV, 7z/RAR, scanned-PDF text, audio trimming
